sendResetPasswordEmail.subject: Bianca Wellness - Password Reset Request
sendResetPasswordEmail.text:
Dear caregiver,

We received a request to reset your Bianca Wellness account password.

To reset your password, please click the link below:

%s

This reset link will expire in 1 hour for security purposes.

If you did not request a password reset, please ignore this email. Your account remains secure.

Best regards,
The Bianca Wellness Team

patientConsentEmail.subject: Bianca Wellness - Consent Required for Call Recording
patientConsentEmail.title: Consent Required for Call Recording
patientConsentEmail.intro: Your healthcare organization, %s, uses Bianca Wellness to conduct wellness check calls. In accordance with applicable laws in your jurisdiction, we need your consent before we can record these calls.
patientConsentEmail.whyConsent: Some jurisdictions require consent from all parties before a call can be recorded. Your organization has enabled the "Require Patient Consent" setting, which means we need your explicit consent before recording any calls.
patientConsentEmail.consentBenefit1: Your wellness check calls may be recorded for quality assurance and care coordination purposes
patientConsentEmail.consentBenefit2: Recordings will be used to provide summaries and insights to your caregivers
patientConsentEmail.consentBenefit3: Recordings will be stored securely and in compliance with applicable privacy laws
patientConsentEmail.noConsentTitle: What happens if you don't consent:
patientConsentEmail.noConsent1: Calls will still be made, but they will not be recorded
patientConsentEmail.noConsent2: You may still receive wellness check calls from your organization
patientConsentEmail.expiryNote: This consent link will expire in 30 days for security purposes.
patientConsentEmail.contactInfo: If you have any questions or concerns, please contact your organization or email us at privacy@biancawellness.com.
patientConsentEmail.closing:
Best regards,
The Bianca Wellness Team
